description: [DEPRECATED] A lightweight portal to view, manage your HTPC apps without having to run anything more than a PHP enabled webserver. With Muximux you don't need to keep multiple tabs open, or bookmark the URL to all of your apps. [DEPRECATED] The upstream Muximux project is unmaintained and this image is on LinuxServer.io's deprecated images list. Consider Homarr, Organizr, or Heimdall instead (also available in this app list).
